rows.title: Evaluating Caffeine Intake and Reduction in Patients with Lower Urinary Tract Symptoms (LUTS).
rows.evidence_boundary: The article proposes a structured exposure-assessment and reduction framework based on guideline consensus; it is not a randomized efficacy trial of caffeine reduction.

rows.title: Ayurveda Treatments for Insomnia: A Narrative Review.
rows.evidence_boundary: Ayurvedic insomnia approaches combine herbs, external therapies, and lifestyle regimens with heterogeneous evidence quality; multi-component interventions limit ingredient-specific attribution.

rows.title: Non-Conventional Yeasts with Probiotic Potential: Diversity, Functional Role, Sustainable Bioprocessing and Local Relevance.
rows.evidence_boundary: Most non-Saccharomyces probiotic evidence remains in vitro or animal-based, and safety is strain-specific; clinical efficacy and long-term human safety require direct validation.

rows.title: Cannabigerol at the Interface of the Gut Microbiota and EndoCannabinoidome: Mechanistic Insights into Inflammation and Pain Modulation.
rows.evidence_boundary: The proposed CBG–microbiota–endocannabinoidome interaction is mechanistically plausible but lacks direct experiments establishing the bidirectional pathway or clinical efficacy.

rows.title: Beyond Composition: Processing-Driven Transformations and Functional Trade-Offs of Matcha Tea in Foods.
rows.evidence_boundary: The review focuses on processing, stability, food-matrix interactions, and bioaccessibility of matcha constituents; these properties are not equivalent to demonstrated clinical health effects.
